stories.label: Iran crisis — university protests erupt as nuclear ultimatum deadline nears
stories.summary: University protests continuing as deadline approaches Feb 23-24. Pezeshkian says Iran will not 'bow' to pressure. Trump open to 'token' enrichment. Pentagon has strike plans. Not selected this cycle — heavily covered, no major new development since last cycle.

stories.label: US tariff upheaval — capital flight accelerates after 15% hike
stories.summary: Capital flight from US markets accelerating as investors shift billions to emerging markets, Europe, and Japan. Weaker dollar and tariff chaos eroding confidence. SCOTUS struck down IEEPA tariffs 6-3. Trump at 15% via Section 122. Constitutional confrontation deepening.

stories.label: Pakistan NW security crisis — military strikes 7 camps after Bannu attack
stories.summary: Pakistan struck 7 TTP and IS-affiliated camps along the Afghan border in retaliation for the Bannu suicide attack that killed a lieutenant colonel. Significant military escalation in the northwest.

stories.label: Sudan war — Museveni hosts RSF leader Dagalo for dialogue
stories.summary: Uganda's Museveni hosting RSF leader Dagalo for high-level dialogue at State House. Controversial given UN genocide finding. Diplomatic track may be only path to ending the war but legitimizes RSF leadership.

stories.label: IS declares new campaign against Syria's post-Assad government
stories.summary: IS released first spokesperson audio in 2 years, declaring priority is overthrowing Sharaa's government. Claimed two attacks in Raqqa and Deir al-Zor. UN reports 5 failed assassination attempts on Sharaa. IS dispersing cadres from deserts into cities.

stories.label: Wall Street exodus — investors shifting billions from US to overseas markets
stories.summary: US investors moving billions into emerging markets, Europe, and Japan. Weaker dollar and tariff uncertainty eroding American exceptionalism. Direct consequence of SCOTUS ruling and Section 122 tariff hike.

stories.label: Chinese chipmaker CXMT undercuts global DDR4 prices by half
stories.summary: CXMT offering DDR4 memory chips at roughly 50% below Samsung/SK Hynix/Micron prices. Despite US export controls on advanced chips, China competing aggressively on mature node memory. Threatens established players' business models.

stories.label: Ancient Australian salt caverns explored as massive energy storage
stories.summary: Geologists drilling into pre-dinosaur salt caverns in Queensland's Adavale Basin for compressed-air energy storage. Could power millions of homes and solve renewable intermittency at grid scale.

stories.label: Germany's CDU/CSU seeks social media ban for under-14s
stories.summary: Germany's ruling CDU/CSU passed motion to ban social media for children under 14 with mandatory digital age verification. Part of global regulatory wave following UK and Australia.

stories.label: Five European nations pledge drone defense production using Ukrainian expertise
stories.summary: E5 nations (France, Poland, Germany, UK, Italy) pledge to leverage Ukraine's battlefield drone expertise for low-cost air defense production. Includes 'drone wall' along Russian border.

stories.label: NASA Artemis II delayed past March over SLS rocket issue
stories.summary: Technical issue with SLS rocket pushes Artemis II from March to at least April. First crewed mission beyond Earth orbit since Apollo 17 continues to face delays.

stories.label: Wikipedia bans Archive.today over DDoS attacks and altered captures
stories.summary: Wikipedia deprecated Archive.today and began removing links after the archiving service conducted DDoS attacks and altered archived web captures.

stories.label: Philippine senator demands SCS pushback from disputed Thitu Island
stories.summary: Philippine senator visited Thitu Island in the Spratlys to call for deepening defense partnerships and continuous pushback against Chinese encroachment.

stories.label: Deepest-ever rock core extracted from under Antarctic ice sheet
stories.summary: Scientists extracted the deepest rock core ever drilled through Antarctic ice, providing unprecedented data about ice sheet stability and sea level rise.

stories.label: Israel-Lebanon ceasefire collapse — Hezbollah declares resistance only option
stories.summary: Israeli strikes killing 10+ in recent days including senior Hezbollah official. Hezbollah declared 'resistance' the only option. Ceasefire effectively dead. Israel may be preemptively degrading Hezbollah ahead of possible Iran strike.

stories.label: Ukraine-Russia conflict — talks stalled, military escalation continues
stories.summary: Military escalation continues with Ukraine striking deep inside Russia. Diplomatic talks stalled since third Geneva round. European nations leveraging Ukrainian drone expertise for defense production.

stories.label: Ethiopia-Tigray-Eritrea: Troop movements raise renewed conflict fears
stories.summary: Military troop movements near Eritrea-Tigray border. 2022 Pretoria peace agreement may be unraveling. Tigray war killed 300-500K people.

stories.label: Trump to visit China March 31-April 2 for summit with Xi
stories.summary: Trump to visit China March 31-April 2. First face-to-face with Xi this term. Now colored by tariff escalation to 15%.

stories.label: China's tech giants recruit AI and semiconductor talent in the US
stories.summary: Chinese tech companies aggressively recruiting AI and semiconductor talent in the US.

stories.label: EU excludes China from critical tech research programmes
stories.summary: EU excluded Chinese researchers and institutions from AI, semiconductor, and critical tech programmes.

stories.label: Venezuela amnesty process expanding — 1,500+ requests received
stories.summary: Venezuela granted amnesty to 379 political prisoners. 1,500+ additional requests received under fast-track protocol.

stories.label: Albania clashes as protesters demand PM Rama resign
stories.summary: Violent protests near Albania's parliament. Demonstrators demand Rama resign over corruption.

stories.label: DeepMind spinoff unveils 'AlphaFold 4' for drug discovery
stories.summary: Isomorphic Labs released new AI model for full molecular interaction modeling.

stories.label: Nigeria Lassa fever outbreak — 22% fatality rate
stories.summary: Lassa fever outbreak in Nigeria at 22% case fatality rate with 15 healthcare workers infected.

stories.label: India-Brazil critical minerals deal to reduce China dependence
stories.summary: India and Brazil signed critical minerals/rare earths cooperation agreement during Lula's Delhi visit.

stories.label: US scientists organize to protect research from political pressure
stories.summary: At AAAS annual meeting, dominant theme is protecting research and institutional independence from political interference.

stories.label: US to reopen embassy in Syria after 14 years
stories.summary: US State Department notified Congress of intent to reopen Damascus embassy.

stories.label: OpenAI flagged school shooter but did not alert police
stories.summary: OpenAI flagged shooter's account months before Canadian school shooting but chose not to alert police.

stories.label: US ambassador endorses Israeli expansion across Middle East
stories.summary: US ambassador Huckabee told Tucker Carlson it would be 'fine' if Israel expanded from Nile to Euphrates. 11 Arab/Muslim states condemned the remarks.

stories.label: Saudi-UAE rift over Sudan RSF and Yemen STC
stories.summary: MBS sent detailed complaint to UAE over Emirati support for Sudan's RSF and Yemen's STC.

stories.label: Giant tortoises return to Galapagos island after century
stories.summary: 150+ giant tortoises reintroduced to Floreana Island. Decades-long breeding programme success.

stories.label: Thailand election may be voided over barcode blunder
stories.summary: Annulment threat over barcode printing error in ballots. Court ruling expected soon.
